slices.title: Refresh the @oh-my-pi dev dependencies to the current published release
slices.done_when: `bun pm ls --all` reports @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent at exactly the version `npm view @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent version` prints (18.20.2 at planning time), package.json still declares `latest`, and `bun run check` now fails only on the host symbols this child deletes (`QuestionResult` imported by src/result.ts, `recoverAskQuestions` imported by test/schema.test.ts).

slices.title: Return the host's `{answers}` shape from the full-screen page
slices.done_when: With the contract's fixed driver saved verbatim as /tmp/a3-sheet.ts, `SRC=$PWD bun /tmp/a3-sheet.ts` exits 0: submit/timeout/cancel/dismissed `details` hold only `answers` (`retry|指数退避`, `cache|手动清空`, `""` for the unanswered one) with no `results` and no `timedOut`, the model text keeps `User answers:` plus its `id: …` / `(cancelled)` / `(timed out:` lines, and `askToolRenderer.describeResult` returns no warning tone, target `重试应该怎么做？`, one answer row per question and `(no answer)` for the unanswered one.

slices.title: Judge the readability of exactly what the generated form shows
slices.done_when: With the contract's fixed driver saved verbatim as /tmp/a3-gate.ts, `SRC=$PWD bun /tmp/a3-gate.ts` exits 0: every native-surface state carries the header, the question, each label and each tradeoff and none of the brief, `description` or `preview`, and the native advisory no longer says the brief and tradeoffs are not shown. (Lands before delegate-html-form because it removes the last reader of `optionSchema.preview`, which that slice deletes.)

slices.title: Delegate one generated HTML form and drop the option projection
slices.done_when: With the contract's fixed driver saved verbatim as /tmp/a3-delegate.ts, `SRC=$PWD bun /tmp/a3-delegate.ts` prints `payloadKeys: ["html"]`, `payloadHasQuestions: false`, both questions and both contexts with the `label: tradeoff` lines, `固定 3 次 & 放弃 <fast>` unchanged, the recommended option `checked`, names `retry,cache`, `fallbackSamePayload: true` and `passThrough: true` from both the `rpc` and the failed-sheet call, `bun run check && bun test` exit 0 on the current host types, and `rg -n -e QuestionResult -e nativeQuestion -e recoverAskQuestions -e preview index.ts src test` finds nothing; the row's `answers[1].answer === "手动清空"` reading still needs the decision in open point `answers-free-text-prefix` before the script can exit 0.

slices.title: Rewrite the README/design sections, the result topic and the file header for the two surfaces
slices.done_when: The README `What the model sends and gets` / `Readability check` / `Sessions without the TUI` / `Known limitations` sections, their design.md counterparts and the zh-CN mirrors state that delegation sends one HTML form, what each surface's `details` and model text are, that `/tree` only moves the leaf, and that the card draws each question with its answer; `src/topics/results.md` explains both the page's `id: …` lines and the host JSON the delegated call returns; and none of `results is the native one`, `/tree` reopening the extended ask, the timed-out question drawn as `Cancelled`, `hands every question's native fields to the native ask`, or an `options[{label, description?, preview?}]` parameter remains in those files.

slices.title: Drive acceptance rows 5–7 in the OrbStack sandbox on the pushed PR head
slices.done_when: In one sandbox started by `bun sandbox/sandbox.ts hold`, with /work/omp-ask-more checked out at the PR head, `bun install` run and `omp plugin link /work/omp-ask-more` done, `MODEL=<model> bun /tmp/a3-rpc.ts <run>` exits 0 with at least one `selectionMarker: "radio"` select whose `title` is the `label: tradeoff` lines then the question and whose options are the two labels, that ask's toolResult starting `User answers:\n{`, and no `html.length` on the console; the TUI session still shows the sheet (brief, evidence, demo, `Other…`), answers, cancels on `esc` and times out; `/tree` on that ask result moves the leaf without opening a form; and the two verification docs' `not yet exercised` lists match what was run.

open_points.point: Acceptance row 1 reads the same field's free-text answer two ways: `answers[1].answer` must be the bare `手动清空`, while `otherAnswer` for the same field must be `Other: 自定义`. The host's `answerText` prefixes `Other: ` on every submitted value that is not an option value, and it is that function the row's readings come from, so both readings cannot hold for one form. 结果 2 (`answer` 是所选项 label 或 Other 的自由文本) and the decision row (`answer` 是所选项 `label`／自填文本／未答空串) state the same field both bare and prefixed.
open_points.input: the plugin-generated radio group for the driver's `cache` question (options `TTL 60s`, `写时失效`) submitted as `{cache: "手动清空"}` and as `{cache: "自定义"}` through `formAnswers`
outputs: `answer` is `Other: 手动清空` / `Other: 自定义` — what `packages/tui/src/html-form/data.ts` `answerText` returns for a non-option value
`answer` is the bare `手动清空` / `自定义` — what row 1 asserts for `answers` and what this plugin's own page returns for a custom answer
open_points.searched: Read the fixed driver text in the contract (both `answers` and `otherAnswer` assertions), the 18.20.2 package `html-form/data.ts:118-258` and `html-form/parse.ts:214-582`, and src/result.ts:8-64 for the sheet-side answer text.

open_points.point: The decision requires every option `label` to be single-line with normalized whitespace and to be rejected otherwise (so a submitted value comes back equal to the model's label). It does not say whether that rule also rejects a `tui` call that the full-screen page answers, where no form is built; 结果 4 [保持] says the page's own behavior does not change, and nothing about label shape is checked today.
open_points.input: `ask({questions:[{id:"a",question:"选哪个？",brief:{where:"w",what:"d",how:"h"},options:[{label:"two\nlines",tradeoff:"t1"},{label:"b",tradeoff:"t2"}]}]})` in a session with `hasUI: true, mode: "tui"`
outputs: the call is rejected before the page opens, naming `questions[0].options[0].label`
the call is accepted and the page draws the label exactly as the model wrote it (today's behavior, which 结果 4 asks to keep)
open_points.producer: src/schema.ts:126 (optionParamSchema.label is `z.string().min(1)`; src/schema.ts:384-390 requires only non-empty, non-reserved, non-duplicate)
open_points.searched: Read src/schema.ts:90-107,124-144,179-183,372-403; src/component.ts:320-345 and src/nodes.ts:255-275 for how option labels are drawn; test/schema.test.ts:142-266 for the existing validate cases (none constrains label shape).

open_points.point: 结果 2 and 结果 3 require both surfaces to return `{answers}` whose `question` is 题干. Only the delegated one is rebuilt by the host, which runs it through `oneLine`, so the same call yields different `answers[].question` on the page and through the form (and a string different from the model's own text) whenever the question holds a line break or a doubled space. Nothing in the contract rules on a multi-line `question`.
open_points.input: `question: "第一句。\n第二句。"`, asked once in a `tui` session (page answers) and once in an `rpc` session (form delegated), both submitted
outputs: delegated `answers[0].question` is `第一句。 第二句。`, the page's `answers[0].question` keeps the newline
both surfaces return the model's exact text (the plugin and the host both normalize, or neither does)
the call is rejected at validation because a question must be one line
open_points.searched: Read src/schema.ts:100-107,135-144,372-378; host `html-form/data.ts:138-157` (`fieldQuestions` → `oneLine`) and `:256-258` (`oneLine` definition); src/result.ts for the page-side `question` source.

open_points.point: `RESERVED_LABELS` rejects only the exact rows a surface adds. The host form drops its free-text `Other` row for the whole question as soon as one option label starts with `Other` (`/^\s*other\b/i`), so a label that merely begins with the word passes validation and silently takes the reader's free-text answer away. The decision says the reserved labels are the rows the surfaces really add and says nothing about this suppression.
outputs: accepted: the delegated form has `other: false`, so the reader can only pick the two options
rejected as a label that removes a row the UI adds
open_points.searched: Read src/schema.ts:23-28 (exact-match map) and :384-390 (lookup by exact label); host `html-form/parse.ts:246-249` for the suppression regex; grepped src/test for `other` handling — only src/component.ts:333 and src/state.ts `onOther` (page-side).

open_points.point: The decision names the page's added row as `Other…`, but the page renders it through `tr("Other…", "其他…")`, so in a Chinese session the row the UI adds reads `其他…` and is not in `RESERVED_LABELS`; a model label equal to it duplicates a row the UI adds. The wording names only the English row.
outputs: accepted: the zh page shows its own `其他…` row next to an option row reading `其他…`
rejected as a row the UI adds
open_points.searched: Read src/component.ts:337 (`tr("Other…", "其他…")`), src/nodes.ts:267 (answer row `tr("Other", "其他")`), src/schema.ts:23-28, src/i18n.ts.

gate_gaps.row: 决策表「可读性检查的 native 面」的保留标签替换（宿主表单的 `Other`、插件页面的 `Other…`；删掉 `Other (type your own)`、`Chat about this`、`Next →`）
